brief_title: CS02 vs Placebo With Metformin in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM)
official_title: A Phase II, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of CS02 Tablet in Combination With Metformin in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Who Have Inadequate Glycemic Control on Metformin Alone

primary_outcomes.measure: The HbA1c treatment effect among CS02 groups and the Placebo group

brief_summary: The objective of the study is to compare the efficacy and safety of 3 doses CS02 Tablet in combination with a stable dose of metformin monotherapy against CS02 PTM (placebo) Tablet in combination with a stable dose of metformin monotherapy over a 12 weeks treatment period in subjects with type 2 diabetes mellitus with inadequate glycemic control on metformin alone.
